items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: This little band there, we used to travel around a little old model there ford. This guy here was named Fliver Ford.

ctx.x: Yeah, I wondered when he retired. I didn't know. Oh, I didn't know.

I forgot after, because I had left town. I didn't know what happened to him after that, until I saw him at the jazz club, you know? Because I was going for about five years there, one trip. I didn't think I made 109 towns in one year. Gee, I was really jumping. I'd make an overnight jump for 500 miles, and I'd leave out of Jackson, Mississippi, and jump into Jackson, Tennessee, or something like that, you know? I'd play there maybe one night or two nights, and then I was going again. I could jump up to, around…
Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
